name: input-otp
title: Input OTP
description: A one-time code in joined 40px slots, the active slot in brand blue with a blinking caret.
usage: Enter a short verification code (six digits for sign-in or a sensitive change). Set maxLength, and pattern={REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS} for numbers; onComplete fires when the code is full. Pasting a whole code and SMS autofill work. Say where the code was sent in the help line.
avoid: A code field without a resend action nearby

reference.source: Extrapolated from the dashboard's field (context-dashboard c0ddf7a src/components/ui/form.tsx, INPUT_CLASS)
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
